description: A farm wants to know which seed lots or feed lots should be used, tested, rotated, or retired based on age, storage conditions, intended use, and known performance history.

user_profile.persona: 44-year-old farm owner trying to reduce waste without relying on guesswork
user_profile.context: Supplies have accumulated over several seasons, and the cost of using the wrong stock is no longer trivial
user_profile.communication_style: Inventory-aware and pragmatic, wants action labels rather than vague monitoring

fact_sheet.fact: Corn seed lot CORN-P2022-01A, purchased from Prairie Grains Co., has a current quantity of 25 bags (50 lbs each).
The action label for corn seed lot CORN-P2022-01A is 'TEST GERMINATION' due to its purchase date of October 15, 2022.
Soybean seed lot SOY-X2024-05C was received on March 1, 2024, from supplier AgriSeed Innovators.
The action label for soybean seed lot SOY-X2024-05C is 'USE FIRST' for the upcoming planting season in the East Field.
Hog finisher feed lot HOGFEED-AN2023-B3 has 1.5 tons remaining and is stored in Silo 2.
The action label for feed lot HOGFEED-AN2023-B3 is 'ROTATE TO BACK' as its 'best by' date is December 31, 2024.
Cattle protein supplement CATL-PRO-S2023-09F was opened on February 15, 2024, and has an open-container shelf life of 6 months.
The action label for cattle supplement CATL-PRO-S2023-09F is 'USE BY 08/15/2024'.
The temperature in the climate-controlled Seed Shed is maintained at a constant 55°F (+/- 2°F).
The humidity alarm for the Seed Shed is set to trigger if relative humidity levels exceed 45% for more than one hour.
Silo 2, containing hog feed, recorded a peak internal temperature of 85°F on July 12, 2023, which is above the recommended 75°F maximum.
Corn seed lot CORN-P2021-11B (now fully retired) had a tested germination rate of only 78% in the 2022 season, below the 90% threshold.
The standard procedure for any seed lot testing below an 85% germination rate is to label it 'RETIRE' for composting.
Soybean lot SOY-X2023-04A from Prairie Grains Co. yielded an average of 62 bushels per acre in the West Field last season.
Hog feed lot HOGFEED-AN2023-A1 resulted in an average daily weight gain of 1.8 lbs per head, which is 5% above the farm's target of 1.72 lbs.
The primary contact at Prairie Grains Co. is Sarah Jenkins, reachable at s.jenkins@prairiegrainsco.net or (555) 823-4455.
AgriNutrient Solutions offers a 5% discount on feed orders over 10 tons placed before March 1st each year.
The farm's inventory is tracked in a Google Sheet named 'GVA Inventory 2024', accessible via a shared link on the office computer's desktop.
Farm owner Alex Chen performs a full physical inventory count on the first Monday of each quarter (Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct).
Alfalfa seed lot ALF-G2023-07D is designated for overseeding Pasture 3 in Fall 2024 and has 8 bags remaining.
The action label for alfalfa seed lot ALF-G2023-07D is 'HOLD FOR FALL USE'.
There are 12 bags of calf starter feed CALF-ST-M2024-01A stored in the Dry Barn, Bay 2.
The action label for calf starter CALF-ST-M2024-01A is 'USE FIRST' as it is the newest stock for the current calving season.
The Dry Barn, Bay 2, has a known roof leak near the west wall, which was last patched on April 10, 2024.
Any stock stored in the Dry Barn must be kept on pallets at least 4 inches off the concrete floor to prevent moisture damage.
A standard germination test involves placing 100 seeds on a damp paper towel in a sealed bag at 70°F for 7 days and counting sprouts.
A feed sample from any lot older than 18 months must be sent to Midwest Labs for mycotoxin screening before use; cost is $75 per sample.
The last order from AgriNutrient Solutions (PO #45881) on February 20, 2024, was for 5 tons of HOGFEED-AN2024-C1.
Feed lot HOGFEED-AN2024-C1 is currently stored in Silo 1 and has a 'best by' date of February 20, 2026.
The intended use for corn seed lot CORN-P2022-01A was the high-moisture soil of the River Bottom field, which requires a minimum 95% germination rate for optimal yield.
Inventory action labels ('USE FIRST', 'TEST', 'ROTATE', 'RETIRE') are updated weekly in column 'G' of the 'GVA Inventory 2024' spreadsheet.
